title: Tamil Nadu Signs 97 MoUs for ₹67,452 Crore Investment

blocks.content: Tamil Nadu signed 97 fresh Memoranda of Understanding in Chennai on 13 August 2026 with a total investment commitment of ₹67,452 crore. The agreements were signed at the first Vettri Tamil Nadu Investors Conclave 2026 under the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam government, which assumed office in May 2026.

items: Tamil Nadu is one of India’s leading industrial states and has a large base in automobiles, electronics, textiles, and engineering goods.
Chennai is a major industrial and automobile hub in India and hosts several large manufacturing and export units.
A Memorandum of Understanding is not the same as a final commercial contract, but it records the intent to invest or collaborate.
Data centres, life sciences, and renewables are among the fastest-growing investment sectors in Indian state industrial policies.
